Nucleophilic aromatic substitution / Buchwald-Hartwig-type amination: 2-bromo-4-fluoroanisole reacts with N-methylpiperazine, displacing the activated aryl fluoride (para to OMe, ortho to Br which further activates the ring) to install the piperazine nitrogen. This is a classical SNAr disconnection for aryl-piperazine motifs bearing an electron-withdrawing/activating halogen pattern.
